review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 18 physical PDF pages, plus a global numeric-token multiset comparison (all differences resolved as page numbers, the arXiv margin stamp, reference-ID line splits and image-hash fragments). Pages 1, 4, 7, 13 and 14 were rendered (dpi 110-200) and visually reviewed: title block and footnote, Figure 2 banner, equations (2)-(3), Table 3 and the Figure 6 leaderboard with Table 4. The Figure 6 screenshot has no PDF text layer, so its OCR HTML table was checked cell-by-cell against renders, including a 200-dpi crop of the Samples column. No code-fence defects; heading, image and table structure is intact. Equation (3) OCR-spaced digits (5 0, 1 6, 8 0 0) and the wide spacing in m _ {<   t} render identically under math typesetting and were left unchanged; the space before commas after inline math in Table 1 cells is repaired by the shared OCR normalizer rather than a document patch.
